interface.name: aqueous_input_activity_manager_v1

description.summary: authorized coarse activity on the existing display

interface.description: Discovery grants no access. Only a single authorized shell connection may subscribe. Input values, counts, positions and input timestamps are never sent. Authorization is scoped to this interface. Normal denial/revocation must not disconnect the shared display. See the installed companion document for the bootstrap, limits and client lifecycle obligations.

request.name: authorize

description.summary: consume a single-use instance and process-bound capability

request.description: Always closes the received FD. Forged, expired or consumed capabilities return permission_denied. Successful authorization applies only to the requesting wl_client and is lost on manager destruction or owner death.

interface.name: aqueous_input_activity_v1
interface.description: One subscription per owner. It starts suspended. Changes of source gates invalidate readiness and advance generation. Acknowledge each notification; no more than one is in flight. Old buckets are dropped, never replayed. Destroyed/revoked parent managers leave this object inert until destroy.

request.name: inhibit

description.summary: suspend before lock preparation or authentication

request.description: Creation adds an independent inhibit. The state event acknowledging serial is sent only after counts/flags and readiness are invalidated. Destroying one inhibitor never clears other inhibits. Reasons and authentication contents are not sent to the compositor.

arg.name: serial
arg.summary: acknowledged request, zero for unsolicited state

arg.name: sequence
arg.summary: delivered notification ordinal, never input count

interface.name: aqueous_input_activity_inhibitor_v1
interface.description: Destroy releases this inhibit only. Resources become inert on subscription destruction. Resuming requires fresh readiness for the new generation.
